purpose: Source-backed dependent-measure acquisition requirements that are necessary to reproduce each PPS study but do not belong in the stimulus, trial, response, or study-schedule contracts. Analysis models and inferential pipelines are intentionally excluded.
canonicalization_rules: Behavioral-only studies bind to the native response log and reference the task_response contract rather than duplicating response mechanics.
EEG, intracranial EEG, TMS/MEP, and other external signals receive explicit acquisition records only when the reviewed publication evidence establishes them.
Unknown device, channel, trigger, clock, epoch, calibration, or outcome-definition details remain unresolved; no toolkit default is promoted to publication evidence.
A non-empirical publication may be marked not_applicable only after its source type has been reviewed; it then has no acquisition records.
